summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating the full, multi-category taxonomy of Private Wealth Management Objectives: Capital Accumulation (Emergency, Home/Real Estate, Business Seed, Education, FIRE, Speculative), Wealth Protection (Asset Protection, FX/Inflation Hedging, Long-Term Care, Income Replacement), Family & Lifestyle (Family Obligations/Elderly Support, Major Milestones, Luxury/Lifestyle), Tax & Mobility (Tax Optimization, Citizenship/Residency by Investment / Golden Visas), and Legacy/Dynasty (Dynasty Trusts, Business Succession, Philanthropy/Endowments).
